description_en: Queries the personal real-name verification status of an IoT card
description_zh: 该接口用于查询物联网卡的个人实名状态
name: GetRealNameStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ICCID of the IoT card.

You can find the ICCID on the IoT card, or view it on the Card Management page of the IoT SIM Service console (https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/sim/card)
parameters.help_zh:
物联网卡的ICCID。

您可在物联网卡上查看ICCID，或者在物联网SIM服务控制台 (https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/sim/card)的卡管理页面查看ICCID
parameters.name: iccid

parameters.help_en: The MSISDNs of sub-cards for multi-network cards
parameters.name: list_msisdns

Code.description_en:
The response code.

200: Success.
Other values: Error code. For more information, see error codes
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码。

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见错误码

Desc.description_en: The description of the verification status

RealNameStatus.description_en:
The personal real-name verification status. Valid values:
NOT_CERTIFIED: not verified.
APPROVING: verification in progress.
CERTIFIED: verified
RealNameStatus.description_zh:
个人实名认证状态。
NOT_CERTIFIED：未认证
APPROVING：认证审核中
CERTIFIED：已认证

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

LocalizedMessage.description_en: The error message displayed in the language corresponding to the current location
LocalizedMessage.description_zh: 根据当前所在地展示对应语言的错误提示

RequestId.description_en: The request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
